name: @battuta/plugin-add-measure
description: A gray measure with a + after the last one: tap it to add a measure, no keyboard needed — for the stylus.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare — nothing to be stale.
dependencies: @battuta/api and nothing else of the workspace. @battuta/core is not here and cannot be added — apps/editor/test/plugin-boundaries.test.ts fails the build on it.
